title: The Ministry of Reconciliation
lead: Paul's name in 2 Corinthians 5:18-20 for the work given to the apostles and, by extension, to the church: to announce that in Christ God was reconciling the world to himself and to plead "be reconciled to God." Reconciliation is Paul's word for the ending of enmity between God and humanity (Romans 5:10-11) and between Jew and Gentile (Ephesians 2:14-16).

sections.b: Paul uses the verb katallasso and the noun katallage in 2 Corinthians 5:18-20 and Romans 5:10-11, and the related verb apokatallasso in Colossians 1:20-22 and Ephesians 2:16. In each, God is the one who acts, and humans are the ones reconciled.

Churches differ on whether the ministry is the preaching of the gospel by every believer, the sacrament of penance and absolution given to the ordained, or the church's office of the keys. See the Where Christians differ cards.
